title: Kya batau maqaam zainab ka
body:
Kya batau maqaam zainab ka
Kya bataun maqaam zainab ka..(2)
Isme aazam hai naam zainab ka
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Mai to kya khud qaseeda padhte hai..(2)
mere bara(12) imaam zainab ka
<<MINI>>
kya batau..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tere darr par bhi aega jibreel.(2)
tu bhi ho ja ghulaam zainab ka
<<MINI>>
kya batau..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Allah Allah hurr teri qismat..(2)
tujhko aaya salaam zainab ka
<<MINI>>
kya batau..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Saare nabiyo se keh raha tha khuda..(2)
dekha tum sab ne kaam zainab ka
<<MINI>>
kya batau..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ban gaya khud alam sa kaghaz par..(2)
likh raha tha mai naam zainab ka
<<MINI>>
kya batau..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Chal raha hai azaa ki surat me..(2)
do jahan me nizaam zainab ka
<<MINI>>
kya batau..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Matam e shaah aur yazeed ke ghar..(2)
dekhlo inteqaam zainab ka
<<MINI>>
kya batau..
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Dekhta hai husain ka sajda..(2)
khud bhi rukh kar qayam zainab ka
<<MINI>>
kya batau..
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Meri behno hijab lazim hai..(2)
hai ye tumko payaam zainab ka
<<MINI>>
kya batau..
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Tera hamsar nahi hai meer koi..(2)
kyu ke tu hai ghulaam zainab ka
<<MINI>>
Kya bataun maqaam zainab ka
Isme aazam hai naam zainab ka
<<DIVIDER>>
author: Mir Hassan Mir
